name: wfc
description: Build reproducible analysis pipelines in Workflow Canvas (wfc) with your agent: set up a project, turn your scripts, or a whole analysis, into pipeline steps, run them and read the results, trying each step as a draft and registering nothing until you agree.

interface.longDescription: Builds reproducible analysis pipelines with you in Workflow Canvas (wfc), a visual dry-lab notebook for reproducible analysis. Teaches the agent how wfc works: projects, modules, methods, samples, envs, pipelines, runs and drafts, with the wfc commands and the rules that matter. It brings a script into wfc as a method by trying it with wfc try and drafting it in the canvas, registers it only when you agree, turns a whole analysis folder into a pipeline you approve step by step, and writes up what changed between your machine and the Linux container.
defaultPrompt: Make this script a wfc method.
Set up a new wfc project here.
Why did my wfc run fail?
